<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>false</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_mukl_dh_metric_cache</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition table="x_mukl_dh_metric_cache">type=Metric^ORtype=Device^EQ<item display_value="Metric" endquery="false" field="type" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value="Metric"/><item display_value="Device" endquery="false" field="type" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="true" value="Device"/><item endquery="true" field="" goto="false" newquery="false" operator="=" or="false" value=""/></filter_condition><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Get Actions</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {
  // get all active actions to then loop through and apply if condition matches current
  // Null conditions mean 'apply to all' so if null condition or condition matches current, add to actions list
  try {
    const uid =
      gs.nil(current.uid) || current.uid == "NULL" ? null : current.uid;

    let matchingActions = new global.GlideQuery("x_mukl_dh_actions")
      .where("active", true)
      .select(["condition", "type", "title"])
      // Remove all actions that are a remote action without a uid
      .filter((action) => action.type != "remote_action" || uid)
      // Create an array of action Sys IDs if the action condition is blank or the condition matches the current record
      .map((action) =>
        gs.nil(action.condition) ||
        GlideFilter.checkRecord(current, action.condition)
          ? action.sys_id.toString()
          : null
      )
      // Filter out null values that are created by the map
      .filter((action) => action)
      .toArray(100);

    current.setValue("actions", matchingActions);
  } catch (err) {
    gs.warn("Error adding actions: " + err);
  }
})(current, previous);
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>peter.watt</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-07-20 13:42:39</sys_created_on><sys_customer_update>false</sys_customer_update><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>fc09f04c9392cf506214fe327cba1005</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Get Actions</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Actionable Eco Device Health" source="x_mukl_dh">9acc633393ca8f506214fe327cba10bf</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_replace_on_upgrade>false</sys_replace_on_upgrade><sys_scope display_value="Actionable Eco Device Health">9acc633393ca8f506214fe327cba10bf</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_fc09f04c9392cf506214fe327cba1005</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>peter.watt</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-07-31 15:08:09</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=fc09f04c9392cf506214fe327cba1005"/></record_update>
